CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Established in the U.S. in 1981, ORIX USA is a diversified investment and asset management firm specializing in credit, real estate, private equity and managed solutions for middle-market borrowers and investors. We combine the strength of our balance sheet with capital from third-party investors, creating strong alignment of interests across our platforms. ORIX USA and its subsidiaries-including ORIX Advisers, ORIX Capital Partners, Signal Peak Capital Management, Boston Financial, Lument, Hilco Global, and NXT Capital-employ approximately 2,100 professionals and manage $43.5 billion in assets and commitments as of June 30, 2026. Our parent company, ORIX Corporation, is a publicly owned, global financial services company with operations in 30 countries and regions worldwide. ORIX's global business platform currently has $573 billion in assets under management. ORIX Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8591) and the New York Stock Exchange (IX).
